name: Overseerr
description: Requests portal for your media server: friends and family browse and request movies/shows; requests flow straight into Radarr/Sonarr.
compose:
services:
  overseerr:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/overseerr:latest
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${{cfg.port}}:5055"
    environment:
      PUID: "1000"
      PGID: "1000"
      TZ: "UTC"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/config
    restart: unless-stopped
